pages.title: Connecting Tables
pages.text: Large dining tables in every wood type. A table with tables on both opposite sides (north and south, or east and west) drops its center stand and becomes a pure tabletop, merging into long banquet surfaces. Break the row and the stands come back.

Right-click a table with any carpet, or with tatami, to spread it as a tablecloth in that color; the cloth drapes over the top. Cut it away with shears to get the cloth back.$(br2)Breaking a table drops both the table and its cloth, so redecorating is free.
